narrative.benchmark_md: Peer set was locked at Batch 1 of Layer 0 research and is immutable for this assessment. Four peers were selected on criteria of: (a) commercial lending emphasis, (b) asset size proximity, (c) geographic overlap, and (d) known Salesforce/nCino deployments for technology benchmarking contrast.
narrative.issue_register_md: Issues identified during research (Layer 0) were confirmed and enriched during assessment scoring (Layer 1). Each issue has a quantified scoring impact: the "Cap Value" column shows the maximum maturity score achievable for affected capability regardless of other evidence. Issues marked MATERIAL represent confirmed technology or process gaps; issues marked MINOR represent governance gaps or regulatory requirements.

per_pillar_md.P1:
WSFS entered 2025-2026 with its most technology-forward executive slate in the institution's 190-year history. FY2025 Annual Report articulates AI and predictive modeling as Objective SO-1, commercial loan growth as SO-2, and efficiency improvement as SO-5 [E-059]. CTO Rene Gonzales joined March 5, 2026 with a documented cloud migration track record at Cenlar FSB [E-093]. Enterprise Architect Mark Staszewski (November 2024) is building the Salesforce Well-Architected CoE from scratch using Portfolio Management, Design Patterns, and Capability Maturity Model methodologies [E-094]. CIO Allan Matyger (May 2025) carries the technology modernization mandate. These are (Digital Strategy) positive signals — but scored at level 2.36 because "AI and Salesforce build-out" remain stated intent rather than deployed capability. The CDO role, vacant since February 2025, continues to limit and governance velocity [E-025].
 Governance & Risk (level 2.61) is WSFS's strongest category. OCC Safety and Soundness examination shows no enforcement actions in the public record. Credit ratings are investment-grade across three agencies (Moody's Baa2, Kroll A-, Morningstar DBRS A(low)) [E-002]. WSFS maintains 22 concentration limits all within board-approved thresholds, and the ERM program tracks 100 key risk indicators with quarterly board reviews [E-043]. Culture & Change Enablement (level 2.29) reflects the Gallup Exceptional Workplace 8 consecutive years and Forbes Best Banks 2025 recognition — but the -0.96 peer gap reveals that strong culture has not yet translated into digital change execution velocity at the platform level.
per_pillar_md.P2:
P2 is WSFS's weakest pillar at level 1.86 — and it carries 20% of the overall CL score weight. The single largest gap in the entire assessment is Onboarding & Fulfillment at level 1.84 vs peer median level 3.25 (-1.41). This reflects the end-to-end manual nature of WSFS's commercial origination journey: financial spreading in Excel [E-066], credit memo generation manually [E-067], and no FSC-based RM pipeline. Jack Henry Banno confirms basic digital banking [E-056], and Terafina confirms consumer account opening [E-056], but the commercial origination journey has no equivalent. Atlantic Union Bankshares (AUB), WSFS's primary peer benchmark, has nCino commercial LOS with Copado automated deployment + Salesforce CRM integrated — the commercial origination journey is digital end-to-end.
 Omnichannel Servicing & Support (level 1.86) reflects the FSC absence directly. The Salesforce Admin job posting (August 2025, confirmed via Dice connector) lists Financial Services Cloud as "a plus" [E-009, E-NEW-003]. This is the most direct possible signal that WSFS aspires to FSC but has not purchased it. Relationship managers operate in Sales+Service Cloud without the household data model, commercial lending actions, or RM pipeline management that FSC provides. Personalization & Proactive Engagement (level 1.89) is connected capped by Data Governance (level 1.93 < 2.5 threshold): WSFS cannot deliver advanced commercial analytics because it lacks the unified commercial data layer. A connected cap was applied per the assessment methodology.
per_pillar_md.P3:
P3 carries 35% of the overall CL score — it is the most financially material pillar in this assessment. The -0.83 P3 gap alone contributes 0.29 of the 0.79 total peer gap. Two MATERIAL issues directly cap and at level 2.0, creating a hard ceiling regardless of other positive evidence. Core Process Automation (level 2.03): financial spreading confirmed as manual via Power Platform / Senior Automation Engineer job posting analysis [E-066]. The nCino Analyst Digital Partner, which became generally available November 2025 and delivers 60-70% credit analyst effort reduction, has not been deployed at WSFS despite 9 years of nCino ownership [E-067]. The agentic credit memo tool from Moody's (May 2026, AWS Marketplace) reduces a 2-week manual process to 5-10 minutes [E-NEW-002] — WSFS is eligible but has not engaged.
 Compliance, Supervision & Surveillance (level 2.15) is the relative bright spot in P3. Kate McGlinchey (SVP CCO, April 2025) joined with a comprehensive compliance program redesign mandate [E-074]. CRA rated Satisfactory (most recent examination) [E-039]. WSFS is named as an OCC REACh participant alongside Wells Fargo, Webster Bank, WaFd, Valley National, and Zions [E-078] — a community reinvestment commitment at institutional scale. No pending enforcement actions found in public record. Business Resilience (level 2.12) benefits from the 25-year CISO tenure of Robert Eastwood, a multi-year enterprise security strategy, and Splunk SIEM confirmed deployment [E-071, E-097]. SR 26-02 (April 2026) creates new model risk governance requirements for WSFS's credit model suite; the NIST AI RMF governs Agentforce as agentic AI [E-102].
per_pillar_md.P4:
P4 contains WSFS's only above-level 2.3 category: Information Security & Cybersecurity at level 2.48. Robert Eastwood, 25-year CISO with 20 years at WSFS specifically, maintains a multi-year enterprise security strategy [E-097]. Splunk SIEM is confirmed deployed [E-071]. FFIEC CAT was sunset August 31, 2025, and WSFS is transitioning to NIST CSF 2.0 per OCC direction [E-098]. Technology Architecture (level 2.31) benefits from the active Salesforce build-out [E-028], AWS infrastructure [E-040], and Jack Henry D1/Banno API-ready digital banking [E-056]. Enterprise Architect Staszewski's CoE methodology (Well-Architected Framework, Portfolio Management, Design Patterns) [E-094] will be the architectural foundation for all future platform decisions.
 Data Management & Governance (level 1.93) is the lowest-scoring category in the assessment. CDO role vacant since February 2025 (level 3 cap applied) [E-025]. Commercial data fragmented across nCino, Salesforce, and treasury management [E-092]. connected dependency: < level 2.5 threshold triggers a cap on Analytics at level 3.0 — meaning analytics capabilities are blocked until data governance is strengthened. Wealth data is now unified (Wealth Access, 7 systems → 1, Dec 2025) [E-088], but this explicitly surfaces the commercial data gap by contrast. Nick Ferrante (VP Enterprise Data Manager) carries an AI/ML enablement mandate [E-087] without C-suite authority. Analytics & AI Enablement (level 1.97): Agentforce confirmed at NewLane Finance [E-058]; Krishna Chaitanya holds Agentforce Specialist certification (August 2025) [E-090]; ARS 2025 confirms "evaluating AI models" [E-059]. The certification and subsidiary pilot represent readiness, not deployment. SR 26-02 (April 2026) covers traditional quantitative models; NIST AI RMF governs Agentforce as agentic AI [E-102].
